_note: Road Mileage Allowance (RMA) for officers, rupees per km, by the state the journey starts in. Transcribed from the owner-supplied scan of PCDA(O) Pune Wing Circular no. 10 (T-Wing), 2 pages, on 2026-10-11. NOT wired to figures.json or the bundle yet: a per-km-by-state figure mode needs code (plan 21, P1 and P3). Spelling follows the circular ('Gujrat', 'Chattisgarh', 'Tamilnadu'); the app maps its own state list to these names.

source.document: Wing Circular no. 10, No. TSS/Gen/Corr, Sub: Road Mileage Allowance: Officers
source.issuer: Office of the PCDA (Officers) Pune, T-Wing (signed by the Wing Officer)
source.effect: From immediate effect, no retrospective effect
source.reason_given: Consequent upon revision of DA rate to 50%
source.evidence_detail: The owner's scan of the circular was read page by page. It is a PCDA(O) wing circular, not an MoD letter, and its own authority (the competent authority's approval) is not cited in the text.
source.rule_link: FAQ: car conveyance on a permanent move is paid at the RMA rate of the originating city, whatever the class of city; RMA on temporary duty needs the Rule 40 Note 2 sanction.

owner_instruction: 2026-10-11: use these rates; RMA = distance (from to to) x the rate of the originating state.
approved_note: Owner confirmed on 2026-10-11 that Wing Circular no. 10 is still the latest RMA rate table (plan 21, F3b). Re-check whenever DA steps again or the FAQ watcher reports a change.
not_in_circular: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
not_in_circular_note: Owner, 2026-10-11: no Army presence there, so no rate is given. The app's state picker simply does not list them.
